## Goal

What user-visible objective does this change improve?

## Canonical source

Which invariant, standard, Skill, or adapter owns the behavior?

## Challenger / reuse pass

What existing implementations were considered? State adopt / merge / port / wrap / backport / compose / reject / unresolved where relevant.

## Verification

What targeted tests, evals, runtime proof, or equivalent-work measurements were performed?

## Preservation

What existing behavior, capability, quality, compatibility, and provenance were explicitly preserved?

## Documentation

- [ ] Canonical standard updated
- [ ] Wiki summary/navigation updated if applicable
- [ ] No long policy duplicated unnecessarily
- [ ] No secrets/private data committed
